evidence: Carries the IPC label and changes libmultiprocess connection teardown and src/ipc/capnp/protocol.cpp.
rationale: Fixes node crashes during shutdown caused by in-flight IPC calls continuing to execute on worker threads after node state like chainman has been cleared. In-progress calls such as `Mining.checkBlock` triggered `Assert(m_node.chainman)` aborts found by Antithesis (#35845, #33387); resolving this teardown race is critical for stable IPC operation.
